responsibility: Implements validation of Rust pub(restricted) visibilities against the current module ancestry. It walks visible HIR items while maintaining a stack of enclosing module DefIds, fetches each item's previously resolved ModuleVisibility from mappings, and diagnoses restrictions whose target module is not an ancestor of the defining module, making this file responsible for declaration-site legality of restricted visibility paths rather than use-site privacy enforcement.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the pub-restricted visitor pair: unlike rust-pub-restricted-visitor.h, it actually maintains the ancestor module stack while walking vis-items and reports invalid pub(restricted) paths that do not name an enclosing module.
